summary: No blocking findings; 3 in all. Booted postgres, redis, api, web.

findings.title: api readiness: storage down
steps: No object store on this machine (no Docker); every other check is ok. Environment limit, not the change.

findings.title: Reduced-motion spec wraps globalThis.matchMedia without restoring it
steps: Read the 'the charts under reduced motion' beforeEach
findings.evidence: `const media = globalThis.matchMedia; globalThis.matchMedia = (query: string) => { queries.push(query); return media(query); };` runs in beforeEach with no afterEach restore, so each test adds another wrapper around the previous one and the spy outlives the describe block. Harmless today because the describe is last in the file; restore it in afterEach.

findings.title: Unit test for FR-002 does not check the final drawing, only that the animation stopped
steps: Read 'follow the shared reduced-motion setting while the chart is open'
findings.evidence: `expect(animator.running(chart)).toBe(false); expect(chart.options.animation).toBe(false);` would also pass if the chart froze mid-growth. FR-002 says 'show its final drawing'. The pr-tester flow confirmed the end state on /cockpit: across 8 runs (320/390/1440 px, light/dark, ro/en), the canvas after the switch matched, pixel for pixel, the same chart drawn complete. So the behaviour is right and only the unit proof is thinner than the requirement. Asserting the bar elements' final y in the spec would close it.
